patterns.note: Content sections frequently employ a two-column grid, pairing descriptive text on one side with a visual example (like a code snippet or a Notion UI mock-up) on the other.
Code examples are consistently presented within distinct, slightly rounded blocks using a monospace font, clearly differentiating them from surrounding explanatory text.
The site utilizes a high-contrast color scheme dominated by a deep blue background with white text and content cards, accented by a subtle light lavender for interactive elements and highlights.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling, ensuring persistent access to key site links.
Interactive UI demonstrations, likely rendered using canvas technology, are embedded directly into hero and feature sections, providing dynamic, animated examples of the product's functionality.
The footer features a unique pixel-art style game, 'ntn run', adding a playful and unexpected element that caters to a developer audience.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that maintains its position at the top of the browser window as the user scrolls down the page.
Dynamic and interactive product demonstrations are achieved by embedding canvas-based animations directly into the page content, allowing for complex UI simulations.
A strong visual hierarchy is established by presenting key information and interactive elements on light-colored cards or text against a deep blue background, ensuring high readability and focus.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong hierarchy, complemented by legible body text and distinct monospace code blocks for technical content. Small uppercase labels are used for secondary information and navigation items, adding a structured, technical feel to the interface elements. The hero section features an oversized, bold heading that immediately captures attention, establishing a clear focal point for the page.

standout: The integration of complex, interactive UI examples, likely powered by canvas, directly into the page content is highly distinctive, offering dynamic product demonstrations rather than static images. The playful pixel-art game in the footer also adds a unique, developer-centric personality that breaks from typical corporate design.
